name: add_balcony
description: Add a rectangular balcony or terrace slab with a bounded lightweight railing system on a floor.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier returned by inspect_project.

name: add_door
description: Place a configured door on a canonical wall. Offset is the door center's distance in feet from the wall start point; the same handing, swing, and state drive 2D and 3D.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: add_facade_feature
description: Add a frame, canopy, or sunshade hosted by an exterior wall with exact lightweight geometry.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: add_stairs
description: Add one straight, quarter-turn L-shaped, or half-turn U-shaped stair between adjacent floors. One semantic stair drives plan, 3D, validation, stairwell opening, circulation, and Walk Mode.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier returned by inspect_project.

landingDepth.description: Clear quarter- or half-landing depth in feet; it must be at least the clear flight width.

length.description: Horizontal run of one flight in feet. Straight stairs require at least 6 ft.

stairType.description: Straight uses one flight; l-shaped uses perpendicular flights and a quarter landing; u-shaped uses parallel return flights and a half landing.

turnSide.description: Direction of the 90- or 180-degree turn while ascending the lower flight.

upperFlightLength.description: Upper-flight run for an L-shaped stair. Omit to match the lower flight.

wellWidth.description: Clear gap between parallel U-shaped flights. Use 0 for a compact dog-leg stair.

width.description: Clear width of one stair flight in feet.

name: add_wall
description: Add one straight independent wall segment using start and end coordinates in feet.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier returned by inspect_project.

name: add_window
description: Place a configured window on a canonical wall. Width, height, sill, type, operation, and glazing are shared by the 2D and 3D representations.

clearHeight.description: Known unobstructed opening height when fully open, in feet. Omit if unknown; null clears an existing value.

clearWidth.description: Known unobstructed opening width when fully open, in feet. Omit if unknown; null clears an existing value.

operable.description: Derived from type; a fixed window cannot be operable.

solarHeatGainCoefficient.description: Concept SHGC input; verify against a rated product.

uFactor.description: Concept U-factor in Btu/(h·ft²·°F); verify against a rated product.

visibleTransmittance.description: Concept visible-transmittance input; verify against a rated product.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: adjust_shared_boundary
description: Adjust the complete shared edge of two aligned rectangular rooms atomically. Both rooms retain at least 3 ft; opening hosts, exterior features, and wall finishes are preserved or the entire edit is rejected.

position.description: New shared edge x or y position in feet, inferred from adjacency.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

name: calculate_open_area
description: Calculate open site area outside the gross ground-floor building footprint and the gross site coverage percentage.

name: calculate_room_area
description: Calculate the exact polygon area and bounding dimensions of one room from the live project model.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

name: calculate_total_area
description: Return explicitly named net and gross architectural areas for the active floor and whole building, with definitions that avoid ambiguous coverage values.

name: configure_plot
description: Configure this project's editable land width, length, setbacks, and front-edge orientation in one canonical transaction. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

name: configure_site_boundary
description: Configure the plot boundary wall and adjustable front gate, including height, size, position, style, and lightweight finish.

name: create_floor
description: Create the next building storey and make it active. Use only after the ground-floor layout is established.

name: create_polygon_room
description: Create a custom orthogonal room from 4–12 ordered plan vertices. Edges must be horizontal or vertical and cannot cross.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier returned by inspect_project.

name: create_room
description: Create one rectangular, L-, T-, or U-shaped residential room on a floor using real dimensions in feet. Its canonical boundary walls appear immediately in the shared editor.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier returned by inspect_project.

name.description: Visible room name, such as Bedroom 2.

x.description: Horizontal position in feet from the plot's left edge.

y.description: Position in feet from the front plot boundary.

name: create_room_from_walls
description: Convert a simple closed orthogonal enclosure of 4–12 independent walls into a room and slab, preserving wall IDs, thickness, finishes, and valid openings atomically. Branched networks and overlaps are rejected.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: delete_balcony
description: Delete one balcony or terrace and its derived slab and railing representations.

name: delete_facade_feature
description: Delete one hosted façade frame, canopy, or sunshade from the shared model.

name: delete_opening
description: Delete a door or window from the shared plan. Its 2D symbol, real 3D wall cutout, frame or panel, and navigable opening update together.

openingId.description: Stable door or window identifier returned by inspect_floor.

name: delete_room
description: Delete one room and its derived boundary walls and openings. The transaction is recorded and can be undone in the editor.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

name: delete_stairs
description: Delete a staircase. Its plan symbol, 3D flights, stairwell void, circulation edge, and Walk Mode route are removed together.

stairId.description: Stable stair identifier returned by inspect_floor or add_stairs.

name: delete_wall
description: Delete an independent wall and any openings it hosts. Canonical room-boundary walls cannot be deleted directly; change the room instead.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: export_plan
description: Export the current shared design as structured ArchMorph JSON or a clean SVG floor plan. The export identifies the exact project version.

name: focus_element
description: Visibly focus the current 2D or 3D view on a room, wall, door, window, or stair by stable ID. Omit the ID to fit the whole project.

name: inspect_circulation
description: Inspect the traversable room graph, main entrance, room-to-room door edges, stair edges, unreachable rooms, and invalid circulation elements.

name: inspect_exterior
description: Inspect the flat roof, parapet, site boundary, gate, balconies, terraces, façade features, and per-wall material overrides in the live project.

name: inspect_floor
description: Inspect the rooms, walls, doors, windows, stairs, areas, and findings on one floor. Returns a compact summary by default; ask for full detail only when you need wall connectivity or stair layout geometry.

detail.description: summary keeps every stable ID and dimension; full adds derived geometry.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier returned by inspect_project.

name: inspect_opening
description: Inspect one door or window together with its full architectural configuration and canonical host wall.

openingId.description: Stable door or window identifier returned by inspect_floor.

name: inspect_plot
description: Inspect the live plot dimensions, setbacks, buildable envelope, available area, orientation, and current ground-floor coverage.

name: inspect_project
description: Inspect the complete live ArchMorph project: plot, floors, element counts, current metrics, view state, and validation summary. Call this before planning edits.

name: inspect_room
description: Inspect one room's exact geometry, area, perimeter, boundary walls, openings, and directly adjacent rooms.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

name: inspect_wall
description: Inspect one canonical physical wall, its endpoints, length, exterior/interior status, adjacent rooms, connected wall segments, and hosted openings.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: measure_distance
description: Measure exact straight, horizontal, and vertical distances between two coordinates or element centers/endpoints.

from.description: Either {x,y} or {elementId, anchor}. All coordinates are feet.

to.description: Either {x,y} or {elementId, anchor}. All coordinates are feet.

name: move_room
description: Move one existing room to an exact x/y position in feet. Its walls, openings, metrics, 2D plan, and 3D model update from the same transaction.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

name: move_wall
description: Move an independent wall by a horizontal and vertical delta in feet. Room-controlled walls must be changed by moving or resizing their room.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: rehost_door
description: Move an existing door onto another compatible canonical wall at an exact center offset.

openingId.description: Stable door or window identifier returned by inspect_floor.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: rehost_window
description: Move an existing window onto another compatible canonical wall at an exact center offset.

openingId.description: Stable door or window identifier returned by inspect_floor.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: rename_project
description: Rename the live project. The new name appears in the product header and in every subsequent export filename.

name: resize_room
description: Resize a room to exact dimensions in feet. Optional anchor holds that corner fixed; defaults to north-west.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

name: set_active_floor
description: Make one storey the active floor. The plan, inspector, 3D level presentation, and Walk Mode all follow it, so call this before inspecting or editing another floor visually.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier returned by inspect_project.

name: set_camera
description: Switch to 3D and visibly move the camera to a standard architectural view.

name: set_door_properties
description: Set architectural door width, height, hinge, handing, swing direction, and open/closed state without creating a separate rendering model.

openingId.description: Stable door or window identifier returned by inspect_floor.

name: set_exact_dimension
description: Set one exact dimension or position on a room, opening, or the plot. The change uses the same operation pipeline as manual inspector input.

name: set_exterior_finish
description: Set one lightweight, project-wide exterior facade finish. This changes 3D exterior wall appearance without adding heavy assembly simulation.

name: set_floor_height
description: Change one storey's floor-to-floor height. Every storey above is re-levelled and each connected stair's rise, riser count, and tread depth are recomputed from the new elevations.

floorId.description: Stable floor identifier returned by inspect_project.

name: set_navigation_mode
description: Switch the live 3D canvas between exterior orbit controls and first-person walkthrough controls. Optionally enter a specific room by stable ID.

roomId.description: Optional room to start inside when entering walk mode.

name: set_plot_orientation
description: Set the cardinal direction faced by the plot's front/access edge. The site plan and north arrow update immediately without changing plot dimensions or setbacks.

orientation.description: Cardinal direction faced by the front/access edge of the plot.

name: set_roof
description: Configure the lightweight flat roof parapet and its visual finish. Omitted values remain unchanged.

name: set_wall_finish
description: Set or reset an exterior or independent wall finish. Independent-wall overrides apply to both sides; omit finish to inherit the project palette.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: set_window_properties
description: Set window size, sill height, type, operability, and concept-stage NFRC-style glazing inputs in the shared architectural model.

clearHeight.description: Known unobstructed opening height when fully open, in feet. Omit if unknown; null clears an existing value.

clearWidth.description: Known unobstructed opening width when fully open, in feet. Omit if unknown; null clears an existing value.

openingId.description: Stable door or window identifier returned by inspect_floor.

operable.description: Setting true alone changes a fixed window to casement; false sets type to fixed.

name: split_room_with_wall
description: Explicitly split a rectangular room using a full-span horizontal or vertical independent partition. Creates two spaces and one shared wall while retaining valid openings and finishes; both sides need at least 3 ft.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: switch_view
description: Visibly switch the shared ArchMorph canvas between 2D floor-plan and 3D building modes.

name: take_snapshot
description: Capture the current live 2D plan or 3D canvas after any requested view and camera changes. Returns image metadata and a PNG data URL.

download.description: Also download the PNG in the human's browser.

name: update_balcony
description: Update balcony or terrace geometry, type, finish, and railing without replacing its stable project identity.

name: update_facade_feature
description: Update or rehost a frame, canopy, or sunshade while retaining its stable project identity.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: update_opening
description: Move or resize a door or window using the same opening state consumed by both the 2D plan and exact 3D wall geometry. Omitted properties remain unchanged.

clearHeight.description: Known unobstructed opening height when fully open, in feet. Omit if unknown; null clears an existing value.

clearWidth.description: Known unobstructed opening width when fully open, in feet. Omit if unknown; null clears an existing value.

offset.description: Opening center distance from the wall start, in feet.

openingId.description: Stable door or window identifier returned by inspect_floor.

operable.description: Setting true alone changes a fixed window to casement; false sets type to fixed.

name: update_room
description: Rename a room or change its programmatic type. Room type drives plan colour and the habitability checks, so keep it accurate.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

name: update_room_vertices
description: Replace a room boundary with 4–12 ordered orthogonal vertices. Use this for precise irregular-plan edits; invalid or crossing boundaries are rejected atomically.

roomId.description: Stable room identifier returned by inspect_floor or create_room.

name: update_stairs
description: Move, resize, rotate, reverse, or convert a stair between straight, quarter-turn L-shaped, and half-turn U-shaped configurations while retaining its stable identity.

length.description: Horizontal run of one flight; straight stairs require at least 6 ft.

upperFlightLength.description: Upper-flight run for an L-shaped stair.

name: update_wall
description: Edit independent-wall endpoints, length from the start, or thickness. Rejects invalid geometry and retains hosted openings atomically. Room-boundary geometry belongs to its rooms.

wallId.description: Stable wall identifier returned by inspect_floor, inspect_room, or add_wall.

name: validate_layout
description: Analyze geometry, canonical openings, exterior access, main-entrance reachability, disconnected room groups, and stair connections. Returns structured, correctable findings—not final code certification.

floorId.description: Optional floor to validate; omit to validate the entire project.
